sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:38

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:38:1
items.html:
The Nukva of Atik is made from the first five of the Keter of BON, etc., in AA, in his Nukva, the sorting of the kings began: It has already been explained above in the adjacent item that Atik and AA have a relation like the Rosh of SAG and its Dikna [beard]. Therefore Atik sorted out of BON, for his Nukva, only those discernments over which no flaw whatsoever ruled because of the breaking. For the matter of the bottom Hey in the Einayim, which we discern in the descent of the degrees of SAG of AK, as above, is comparable to the discernment of the records of BON, whose degrees descend according to the measure of the flaw with which they were flawed by force of the breaking of the vessels. And just as in the Rosh of SAG, even though the inclusion of the coupling of the bottom Hey in the Einayim was made in it, this mixture is nevertheless not discernible in it at all, so Atik, which corresponds to it, cannot take for its construction any discernment of BON that was flawed in the least by the breaking of the vessels. Therefore it took from BON nothing but its own Katnut, that is, all that emerged in it from its very emanation, which is only the upper half of the Keter of BON, meaning the discernment of the Galgalta ve Einayim in it alone, which received nothing into themselves, not even from the illumination of the NHY of AK that came out through the Tabur in the discernment of the Holam that is above the letters. And for this reason there is nothing in it of the discernments of the ZAT of Nekudim, since the illumination of the Holam through the Tabur is the root of the ZAT of Nekudim, because that light descended from the coupling of AB SAG that was made upon the MAN [Mayin Nukvin] of the NHY of AK, which rose to them. And the NHY of AK are considered a root for ZON of Nekudim, for it was upon their MAN that AVI raised the ZAT of Nekudim.
Now, this illumination that came out through the Tabur to the Keter of Nekudim lowered the bottom Hey from the Einayim of Keter to the Peh of Nekudim, and returned AVI to the discernment of Rosh, and Keter itself thereby gained its own GAR as well, for now it has complete ten Sefirot, since it attained its AHP through the return of AVI to its Rosh. This is not so before AVI returned to the Rosh, when Keter had nothing but Galgalta ve Einayim alone, which are the discernments of the lights of Ruach Nefesh, as known, for the lights of HGT are clothed in the Galgalta and the lights of NHY are clothed in the Einayim. And therefore, although through the illumination of the Tabur of AK it was completed only in the three lower vessels, Bina and ZON, nevertheless with respect to the lights they restored to it KHB of lights. And these Bina and ZON that Keter gained through the illumination of the NHY of AK are regarded, in relation to Atik, as dross, because a nullification occurred in them at the time of the kings and they fell back to VAK [six ends], which is what is called the nullification of the NHY of Keter, as known.
Therefore Atik gave these Bina and ZON of Keter to AA, since AA corresponds to the discernment of the Dikna of SAG, to the place of the revelation of the Katnut that is found in the Rosh of SAG. And hence AA received the flawed discernments of the Bina and ZON of the Keter of BON for the discernment of his Nukva.
And this is what he says: “the aspect of the Nukva of Atik is made from the first five of the Keter of BON, in which there was never any nullification or flaw whatsoever, not even in the slightest.” That is, as written, that it was made from the discernment of the Katnut of Keter that emerged in it from its very emanation, which remained in wholeness and of which not even the least was nullified. “However, in AA, in his Nukva, the sorting of the kings began, for she was made from the last five of the Keter of BON, in which there was some flaw.” That is, as has been explained, that AA was made from the Bina and ZON of Keter that Keter had gained through the new light of the NHY of AK, which shone to it through the Tabur, which light was subsequently nullified, and the Bina and ZON of Keter descended once more from Rosh to VAK. And hence there is a flaw in them, as explained.

items.html: And from there on the flaws kept increasing in the rest of the Partzufim: For the Bina and ZON that Hochma gained through the light of the NHY of AK that came out through the Tabur are more flawed than the Bina and ZON of Keter, because Hochma also took part in the MAN of the Shuruk, which is the very discernment of the bottom Hey. And the Bina and ZON of the Bina of BON were flawed even more than those of Hochma, because the Bina of Nekudim did not draw her Bina and ZON through the illumination of the Holam, as Aba did, but only through the MAN of the Shuruk that she received from the Yesod of AK, which is the discernment of the self of the bottom Hey, from whom ZON were born. And the discernments of the seven lights of the ZAT are more flawed than all of them, for they are the ones that were broken, anterior and posterior, and descended into BYA.
